# WC24 · Patient 360 · CSKH · Kế hoạch (chỉ xem)

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · state · Next.js: **built (U3)** (`/patients/[id]`) · account `care-maianh`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/staff-context.js#apply`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#plan`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `clinic.js › plan(p)` for role care: `[data-modal="plan-edit"]` ("Chỉnh sửa") is removed, so the plan, goals, tracking criteria and milestones are read-only.
- Inventory note: The plan tab without "Chỉnh sửa" (clinical capability).
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `care-maianh`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role care: consult, session, photos.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role accountant: consult, session, photos, crm.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P001\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"} → {"click":"[data-tab=\"plan\"]"}; it must show "Hồ sơ P001".

## Next.js target
- Route: `/patients/[id]` · status: **built (U3)** · U step: U3
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/patients/[id]` "Patient 360" (owner U1, U3); test ids: `src/lib/ops/format.test.ts`, `src/components/ops/patient/patient-360-view.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/consult-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/plan-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/session-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/photos-tab.test.tsx`, `src/lib/ops/patient-tabs.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/session-form.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/plan-form.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/media-upload.test.ts`
- Existing page file: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/patients/[id]/page.tsx`

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Chăm sóc và phục hồi sau buổi điều trị
- Chưa có đơn từ catalog. (empty state)

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "Chăm sóc và phục hồi sau buổi điều trị"
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
- "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." is what `action()` answers when a clinical command is forced without the capability.

## Differences from the app design
- App J3 "Kế hoạch điều trị" has the button "Điều chỉnh kế hoạch" and the string "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện."; the care variant of the web has no edit button at all.
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in J3: "Chăm sóc và phục hồi sau buổi điều trị"

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.

## Web canvas
- Frames: 1440x900 (inventory: 1440x900); screen label `WC24 · Patient 360 · CSKH · Kế hoạch (chỉ xem)`.
- Canvas note: Web › patients › Patient 360 (CSKH) › Kế hoạch · như WC7 nhưng không có nút "Chỉnh sửa" (quyền chuyên môn); app J3 có "Điều chỉnh kế hoạch" và câu "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện."
